name: Feed
description: Follows RSS, Atom and JSON feeds (blogs, release notes, forums) and reports new entries.
guide: Find the feed address of what you want to follow. Most blogs and forums have one: look for an RSS icon, or try adding /feed or /rss to the address. GitHub releases have one at `https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/releases.atom`.
Paste one address per line below. Press **Test connection** to see that every address can be read.
New entries arrive every few minutes. Entries that are already there when you save are not reported.

setup.help: RSS, Atom or JSON Feed addresses, one per line.
